body:
MAINLINE-066 is filed. QUESTIONABLE. PROJECTION. No qualified hull safety factor. Unreviewed.

The base is gamma 0.20 and equation 2.2-14's Q 0.33, with BETA set to 1, modulus 293.6 GPa, strength 379.2 MPa, and the favorable film. Payloads match DELTA-C within 0.002 kg. Every row co-binds face wrinkling and global buckling. Vc is 1.29 to 1.32, so gamma stays 0.20.

The norm is the L1 sum of nonnegative log factors. Face density alone floats every case. None of 39 pairs beat it. From 1850 kg/m3, the concept target is 993.2 kg/m3, factor 1.8627, set by R 20 optimistic. The TRL 7 target is 1146.0 kg/m3, factor 1.6143. R 30 ISA concept alone is 1061.2 kg/m3, factor 1.7433. These densities are projections.

Modulus closes concept ISA near 614 to 624 GPa and TRL 7 near 557 to 572 GPa, at a higher log cost. Concept optimistic stays negative. Gamma of 1 misses concept R 20 and concept R 30 optimistic. It closes concept R 30 ISA at 0.966 and TRL 7 at 0.45 to 0.61. Q of 0.82 leaves concept R 30 ISA about 40 t short. Strength is flat. Film saves about 2 t. Core density and core modulus cannot close. Core shear loses its geometry near factor 1.2.

At concept R 30 ISA the modulus-to-density ratio is 0.514, between 1/3 and 1. Strength elasticity is 0. Core slopes are about a quarter of face density.

simjob-20261020t175116-2cf59f790fe1 exited 0. Follow-ups were direct re-evaluations on the pinned model.
